coverage_notes: OCHA OPT and WHO were checked first. OCHA surfaced no new in-window Gaza update beyond previously known situation reporting; WHO surfaced no fresh in-window operational health update. Twelve additional bounded targeted searches covered Reuters, AP, UNRWA, WFP, UNICEF, ICRC, Palestine Red Crescent, MSF, WAFA, Al Jazeera, IDF, and UN sources. No search produced a new, traceable qualifying development in the observation window. Retrospective, previously known, non-Gaza, opinion, duplicate, unsupported, and unsourced material was excluded. No source/search failure materially reduced coverage.
